patch_description: Add an accept-only nonsmooth contact-set polishing phase after the continuation optimization. The smooth surrogate is useful for finding the packing basin, but its final iterate can remain slightly below the true ratio optimum because its weights include non-limiting pairs. This refinement uses equal logarithmic forces from pairs near the current minimum and maximum squared distances, performs deterministic backtracking, and retains only strict improvements to the evaluator’s exact squared-distance ratio. It preserves free radial motion through the existing normalization and cannot degrade the candidate returned from any seed.
